0.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_000
0.description: Halt, featherless neuker! The soil upon which you tread, sullied, it is, by talon-less feet! Begone or be supper! Squark!

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_010
1.description: Squark! Here for labor, this one is! State your business or begone!

2.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_020
2.description: Squark! Here for labor, this one is? State your business or begone!

3.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_030
3.description: Squark! No more labor have we for you this day, featherless neuker! State your business or begone!

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_040
10.description: Squark! Our engineers, require more than simply cogs and cranks, they do. Eat, an Ixal must. Train, an Ixal must. Fight, an Ixal must!

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_041
11.description: But leave their work, they must not! Squark! So borrow the talon-less hands of adventurers, we shall. Talon-less hands, good at gathering, they are. Good at pilfering, they are!

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_050
12.description: Ehcatl Nine delivery quests are a type of allied society quest made available once a day (Earth time).

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_051
13.description: In addition to components for their airship, the <hex:021A020203>Dezul Qualan<hex:021A020103>, the Ixal also require other various items to maintain basic faction operations.

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_052
14.description: Delivery quests consist of three simple steps─accepting the quest, procuring the item, and delivering the goods to the Ehcatl Nine foreman.

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_053
15.description: The list of currently sought items can be viewed by either speaking with the foreman, or selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000_060
16.description: Squark! What an Ixal craves, a featherless neuker knows not. Tell you, we shall─of what and how much!

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_070
17.description: Each item delivered will earn you points towards meeting your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>quota<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Only when the quota is met will the quest be deemed complete.

18.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_071
18.description: Each individual delivery will earn you experience points for the class indicated to the left of the item name in the Ehcatl Nine Delivery Quest menu.

19.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_072
19.description: Completing an Ehcatl Nine delivery quest will earn experience points for your job or class at the time of completion, as well as improve your reputation with the faction.

20.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_100_072
20.description: Current quota progress can be viewed in the duty list and journal.

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_100_090
21.description: Squark! Eager, the featherless one is. Good! Good! But patient, you must be!

22.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_090
22.description: Delivery quests may only be accepted once a day (Earth time). Once you have accepted a delivery quest you will not be able to accept another until the following day, regardless of whether you complete or abandon it.

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_091
23.description: Delivery quests will also use one of your allied society quest allowances─an allowance that will not be reimbursed should you choose to abandon the quest.

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_092
24.description: Allowances are replenished once a day (Earth time).

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_100_092
25.description: Please be advised that the list of currently sought items will be updated each day at <hex:0206020103><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time), and items previously sought may no longer be accepted.

26.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_PROCUREMENTIXAL_100_110
26.description: Squark! Some things, we want. Some things, we <hex:021A020203>need<hex:021A020103>. Bring us what we need and much fortune shall you see! Squeee!

27.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_110
27.description: When viewing the list of items sought by the Ehcatl Nine, you may notice entries with a gold star (<hex:0212024403>) to their left.

28.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_111
28.description: This indicates that demand for the items is high, and they will earn you an experience bonus when delivered.

29.name: TEXT_REGFSTIXALSUPPLY_00205_SYSTEM_000_112
29.description: You will also earn extra experience points for delivering high-quality items, regardless of whether or not they are in demand.
